title: Masked-error pattern in 17 more vector generators: (FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError) conflated as staleness
description: Follow-up from 64l2: test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py --check masked atomic_json directory-safety RuntimeErrors as a false 'out-of-date vector file' verdict (a 0775 test/vectors dir made the check lie about staleness). Fixed there (RuntimeError/OSError now 'cannot safely read' + exit 2; FileNotFoundError keeps out-of-date exit 1). The SAME 'except (FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError): current = None' pattern exists in 17 sibling generators (generate_announce_signed_data.py:165, generate_asn_sfn.py:238, generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py:378, generate_capability_announcements.py:377, generate_dao_origin_signature.py:772, generate_delegation_tokens.py:465, generate_forwarding_buffer.py:550, generate_gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.py:534, generate_ipv6_addresses.py:125, generate_ipv6_icmpv6.py:219, + 7 more found by grep). Apply the same split to each (mechanical), verify each generator --check still exits 0 on this host. Also note: the trigger was test/vectors being mode 0775 (group-writable) on worker checkouts — chmod 755 fixes it locally; consider a CI/host guard if it recurs.
close_reason: Converted 16 of the 18 pattern instances to honest --check errors: FileNotFoundError keeps prior staleness semantics; (OSError, RuntimeError) now prints 'cannot safely read <name>: <error>' and exits 2 (return 2 in 14 int-mains; raise SystemExit(2) in forwarding_buffer/rpl_route_state which have main() -> None — that bug in my first patch was caught by the security reviewer and fixed). generate_packets_timing.py loop-shape also converted (unsafe read exits 2 immediately; missing/stale still lists in mismatches). EXCLUDED generate_dao_origin_signature.py: its CLI test deliberately pins the oversized contract (exit 1 'not deterministically generated'); converting needs an atomic_json exception split or a deliberate test-contract update — decision documented on the follow-up bead (updated comment). Verified: py_compile all; ruff all clean; all 16 --check exit 0 on healthy dir; unsafe-dir sample exits 2 with honest message; gateway+CLI suites 263 passed. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (uniformity, OUTPUT/OUTPUT_PATH/OUT vars, sys imports pre-existing, return-2 reachability — caught the 2 None-main bugs), security PASS (fail-closed preserved, no injection surface, FileNotFoundError-before-OSError ordering), edge PASS (missing-file semantics kept; oversize now truthful; no CI consumer depends on exit codes; packets_timing residual flagged and then converted in-round). Generator runs: tests/vectors committed JSON untouched (byte-identical regeneration confirmed in 64l2 round).
